name: canary
description: Context-rot heartbeat: asks Claude to end each reply with a secret footer and warns when it keeps dropping or garbling it

enabled.title: Canary heartbeat
enabled.description: Kill switch. Off registers nothing and runs nothing.

window.title: Window size
window.description: How many recent substantive replies are scored.

missRate.title: Alert miss rate
missRate.description: Share of a full window that must miss the footer before the alert fires (0 to 1).

minProse.title: Low-signal length
minProse.description: Replies with less prose than this (code blocks removed) are not scored.
